app.name: Contact Groups
app.tagline: Your group's contacts in one place.

state.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist or you have no access to it.

error.RECENT_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Sign in again to do this.
error.CONFLICT: This contact was changed by someone else.
error.LAST_OWNER: A group needs at least one Owner. Make another member an Owner first.
error.SOLE_OWNER: You are the only Owner of a group.
error.GROUP_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a group with this name.
error.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the group.
error.INVITATION_PENDING: An invitation for this address is already pending.
error.INVITATION_LIMIT: The limit of 20 pending invitations is reached.
error.TAG_NAME_TAKEN: A tag with this name already exists.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.UNAVAILABLE: The service is not available right now.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Enter your e-mail address and we will send a link to reset the password.
reset.sentText: If an account exists for this address, we sent a link to reset the password.

verify.title: Verify your e-mail
verify.text: We sent a message to {{email}}. Open the link in it, then come back and sign in.

error.wrongCredentials: The e-mail or password is not correct.
error.emailInUse: An account with this e-mail address already exists.
error.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
error.nameTooLong: The name can have up to 100 characters.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.network: The network is not available. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

empty.title: Create a group
empty.text: A group holds your contacts and its members. Create your first group to start.

nameError.TOO_LONG: The name can have at most {{max}} characters.

notFound.title: Group not found
notFound.text: This group does not exist or you are not a member of it.

delete.title: Delete group
delete.text: The group and its contacts go to Trash for 30 days. You can restore it from Deleted groups until then.
delete.label: Type the group name to confirm
delete.hint: Type the name exactly as shown above.
delete.mismatch: The name does not match. Type it exactly, with the same capital letters.

contact.deleteText: The contact moves to Trash. You can restore it there for 30 days.
contact.inTrash: This contact is in Trash and cannot be edited. Restore it from the Trash tab.
contact.tagsHint: Press Enter to add a tag. Letters, digits, - and _; up to 50 characters.

tagError.INVALID_CHARACTERS: Tag names use letters, digits, - and _.
tagError.TOO_LONG: A tag has at most 50 characters.
tagError.TOO_SHORT: A tag needs at least 1 character.
tagError.TOO_MANY: A contact has at most 50 tags.

error.REQUIRED_ONE_OF: Enter at least one of first name, last name, e-mail or company.
error.UNKNOWN_COUNTRY: Choose a country from the list.

conflict.title: This contact was changed by someone else.
conflict.text: The current values are shown below. Your entries are kept next to them.

attributeError.TOO_LONG: A key has at most 50 and a value at most 255 characters.
attributeError.DUPLICATE_KEY: This key is already used on this contact.
attributeError.TOO_MANY: A contact has at most 50 attributes.

members.limitReached: The limit of 20 pending invitations is reached. Cancel one to invite more people.

emailError.TOO_LONG: The e-mail address can have at most 255 characters.

remove.title: Remove member
remove.text: This person loses access to the group. Their contacts stay in the group.

leave.title: Leave group
leave.text: You lose access to this group.

duplicates.intro: Search this group for contacts that are probably the same person.
duplicates.noneText: Every contact in this group looks different.

versions.restoreText: The contact gets the values of this version. A new version is recorded; nothing is lost.
versions.nothingToChange: There is nothing to change: the contact already has these values.
versions.inTrash: The contact is in Trash. Restore it from Trash first, then restore the version.
versions.emptyText: A version is recorded each time the contact is saved.

history.title: History
history.emptyText: Changes to this contact appear here.
history.groupEmptyText: Events in this group appear here.
history.noMatchText: Change the person, the event type or the dates.
history.invalidRange: The end date must not be before the start date.

trash.intro: Contacts stay in Trash for 30 days, then they are erased.
trash.empty: Trash is empty. Deleted contacts stay here for 30 days.
trash.eraseText: The contact and its data are erased now. This cannot be undone. The History keeps only anonymised entries.

tags.name: Tag name
tags.nameHint: Letters, digits, - and _; up to 50 characters.
tags.deleteText: The tag is removed from its contacts. The contacts stay.
tags.empty: No tags yet. Tags you add to contacts appear here.

list.searchHint: Search by name, e-mail, company, city, tag or attribute value
list.emptyEditor: Add the first contact to this group.
list.emptyViewer: Nobody has added a contact to this group yet.

noMatch.title: No contacts match
noMatch.text: Change the search text or the filters.

filter.title: Filter contacts
filter.intro: All conditions and the search text must match. Choose a condition.
filter.tagsHint: Type a tag name and press Enter; suggestions appear.

export.tooMany: You selected more than 10,000 contacts. Narrow the selection to export.
export.error: The export did not work. Please try again.

deletedGroups.intro: Groups stay in Trash for 30 days, then they are erased.
deletedGroups.empty: Groups you delete stay here for 30 days.
deletedGroups.nameClash: You already have a group with this name. Rename that group first, then restore this one.

account.name: Name
account.deleteIntro: Your account is deleted and your e-mail address is removed from the History. Your name stays in the History. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirm: This deletes your account and removes you from all your groups. This cannot be undone.
account.soleOwner: You are the only Owner of these groups. Make another member an Owner or delete the group first.
account.reauthTitle: Sign in again to do this
account.reauthText: For your safety we ask you to sign in again before deleting the account.

merge.title: Merge contacts
merge.conflictsHint: Same key, different values. Choose one per key.
merge.revertHint: You can revert a merge later from the contact’s Versions tab.
